translations.web: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?” ’
translations.bsb: You have relied on your swords, you have committed detestable acts, and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’
translations.kjv: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?
translations.asv: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbor's wife: and shall ye possess the land?
